questions.q: What does Hari argue about the cause of depression?
a: It is not simply a chemical imbalance in the brain
It is passed down entirely through your genes
It comes only from low serotonin levels
It always requires a lifelong prescription
questions.why: The first lesson says Hari uncovered scant proof that low serotonin is the culprit or that the drugs actually help.

questions.q: What did Irving Kirsch discover about antidepressants?
a: Many were no more effective than placebos
They worked far better than talking therapy
They cured the majority of patients studied
They produced almost no side effects
questions.why: The summary says Kirsch reviewed antidepressant research and found many on the market worked no better than a placebo.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the nine causes of depression?
a: Disconnection from meaningful work
A shortage of serotonin in the brain
Too much exposure to green spaces
A lack of prescription medication
questions.why: The second lesson lists disconnection from meaningful work, others, values, status, nature and a hopeful future.

questions.q: What did the comparison of Native American reservations suggest?
a: Control over your own destiny lowers suicide rates
Wealthier reservations had higher depression rates
Traditional medicine was the most effective treatment
Distance from cities increased depression
questions.why: The summary says reservations where people controlled their own laws, elections and schools had far lower suicide rates.
